# Metana

> > Metana offers intensive coding bootcamps in Web3, software engineering, and cybersecurity with guaranteed job placement and $50,000+ salary outcomes.

Metana is a coding bootcamp platform specializing in blockchain and Web3 development (Solidity, Rust, Ethereum, Solana), full-stack software engineering, and cybersecurity training. All programs feature job guarantees, career support through JobCamp, and outcomes-focused curriculum designed for career switchers and aspiring developers.

## Key Topics

- Web3 Development
- Solidity
- Ethereum
- Solana
- Rust
- Smart Contracts
- Blockchain
- Job Guarantee
- Full Stack Engineering
- Cybersecurity
- Career Accelerator
- Bootcamp
- Job Placement
- Coding Education
- DeFi

## Web3 & Blockchain Bootcamps

- [Web3 Solidity Bootcamp (Ethereum Blockchain)](https://metana.io/web3-solidity-bootcamp-ethereum-blockchain): Master Solidity and Ethereum blockchain development in 4-month Web3 bootcamp with job placement
- [Full Stack Web3 Bootcamp](https://metana.io/web3-beginner-bootcamp): Full Stack Web3 beginner bootcamp: 12 weeks fundamentals + 16 weeks advanced Solidity
- [Web3 Rust Bootcamp (Solana Blockchain)](https://metana.io/web3-rust-bootcamp-solana-blockchain): Web3 Rust bootcamp for Solana blockchain development with $70,000+ earning potential

## Software Engineering Programs

- [Full Stack Software Engineer Bootcamp](https://metana.io/full-stack-software-engineer-bootcamp): Full Stack Software Engineer bootcamp: JavaScript, Node.js, React with job guarantee
- [Software Engineering Career Accelerator](https://metana.io/advanced-software-engineering-bootcamp): Software Engineering Career Accelerator for experienced engineers: system design, algorithms

## Career Development & Support

- [Metana's Job Guarantee](https://metana.io/job-guarantee): Metana job guarantee: $50,000+ salary or full tuition refund for bootcamp graduates
- [JobCamp - Career Development and Job Hunting Bootcamp](https://metana.io/jobcamp): JobCamp: career development bootcamp for interviews, networking, job search skills
- [Career Quiz](https://metana.io/career-quiz): Career quiz tool: 90-second assessment for tech role matching and salary estimation

## Cybersecurity Training

- [Cybersecurity Bootcamp](https://metana.io/cybersecurity-bootcamp): Cybersecurity bootcamp: hands-on training, flexible online format with job support
